The user asks: "You are agent B. Choose exactly one task for yourself. ... Write a short handoff for your own fresh successor. ... Return ONLY JSON {"task":"the task you took in the completed round","note":"handoff ..."}."

We need to output JSON with task = the task B took in the completed round. The completed round allocation was given: {"A":"T2","B":"T3","C":"T4","D":"T1"}. So B took T3. So task field = "T3". Then note: a handoff message describing the completed allocation and convention for next round, up to 2000 characters. Must not include experiment-condition labels, must not change task facts. So note should say something like: "In the previous round, A chose T2, B chose T3, C chose T4, D chose T1, achieving 4 distinct tasks, 0 violations, total cost 18, total reward 382. For the next round, tasks are unclaimed again. Follow the same convention: each agent selects one task, then C and D will pick remaining tasks minimizing combined cost, etc." Must be short.

We must ensure no extra keys, only JSON with those two fields.

Return only JSON.
